description.fun: Smeargle's tail oozes a paint-like fluid, a set colour for each Smeargle, and it uses it to mark its territory with over 5,000 known signs, some highly prized by Smeargle fans. The pawprint on its back is a sign that it's grown up. Its signature move, Sketch, permanently copies the last move its opponent used, so it can learn almost any move there is.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon based on a beagle and a painter, with a paintbrush-tipped tail and a beret-like head. It is the only Pokémon that can learn Sketch, which copies other moves. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A beagle painter that can copy almost any move
